Summarize in two sentences: Tidal power converts the rise and fall of the sea into electricity. Barrage designs hold water behind a dam at high tide and release it through turbines; stream designs place turbines directly in fast tidal currents. Output is predictable years ahead because tides follow the moon, but suitable sites are few and construction in salt water is costly. Environmental effects on sediment and fish migration remain under study.
